```{r}

# Load packages
library(tidyverse)

# Read the data
housing <- readRDS("data/housing_clean.rds")

# Keep variables for modeling
# Remove rows with missing prices
housing_model <- housing %>%
  select(Price, Rooms, Type, Distance,
         Bathroom, Car, Landsize, Regionname) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Price)) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = as.factor(Type),
    Regionname = as.factor(Regionname)
  )

# Check the cleaned data
dim(housing_model)
summary(housing_model)
```
